_about: Animated mobs: each an item on an armour stand's head, leather horse armour with this custom model data (from 100001, above every item's), its model a Blockbench model in mobs/models/ whose animations the item shader plays (build_mobs.py bakes them into the model's texture, the mobs stitch plays them). The item's dye names the clip, by the ids here, and when it started; the plugin's mob type (entity_info) wears the same custom model data and names the same clip ids, with each clip's length in ticks, which build_mobs.py prints. Clips are by the model's animation names; end is how a clip ends where the model's own loop setting isn't what the mob wants (loop, once: back to rest, hold: its last frame). scale is the model's size on the stand's head (at most 4).
